hero_sub: Transform your body with Berlin's premier Lagree training — science-backed, results-driven.
about_body_1: Framework is a boutique fitness studio offering a unique blend of Lagree™ training and active physiotherapy. Lagree is a highly intensive full-body muscle endurance workout performed on the Megaformer™ — a revolutionary machine designed to challenge every muscle group simultaneously.
about_body_2: The method focuses on slow-twitch muscle fibers, building lean muscle mass and core strength while staying low-impact on your joints. You'll feel the burn during — and for up to 24 hours after — every session.
cta_sub: Join our community of strong, empowered people across Berlin. Your first class is just one step away.
